issues.concern: The formality tag 'formal' is incorrect for this headword. While '解散' can be used in formal contexts, it is also commonly used in everyday speech and writing (e.g., a band breaking up, a meeting ending). It is not exclusively formal.

The English translation 'The tour was dismissed in front of the station' is unnatural and misleading. 'Dismissed' implies being sent away by an authority, which doesn't fit the context of a tour ending. A more natural translation would be 'The tour ended/broke up in front of the station' or 'The tour group dispersed in front of the station.'
issues.suggestion: The tour ended in front of the station.
